name: 复古帆布皮革扣带登山包款

category.leaf: 复古帆布扣带徒步登山背包

description: 大容量帆布登山背包，皮革扣带复古质感，背负舒适长途不累

styleLock.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF for packshots and infographics, flat misty grey-blue #E8EEF0 panels for cover and CTA, real outdoor locations for scenes
styleLock.lightingSystem: soft directional key light from the left, neutral-cool studio light with soft contact shadows for product shots; natural daylight around 5500K for scenes
styleLock.surfaceSystem: dark matte wood tabletop #3B3230 for tabletop shots, compacted gravel and rock for trail scenes
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif; headlines 28-48pt, subtitles 16-20pt, labels 10-14pt, all in charcoal #33383D
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons only, single accent color #5E969E, rounded pill labels
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle and scale for the backpack across the set; full silhouette visible when not in macro; warm leather-brown #A9683C appears only as small hardware and trim accents inside the photography
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent rugged outdoor travel ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white background #FFFFFF, misty grey-blue panel #E8EEF0, charcoal text #33383D, one dusty teal accent #5E969E, and one warm leather-brown accent #A9683C reserved for hardware and trim details in the photography; neutral-cool lighting with a soft directional key and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif type, headlines 28-48pt, subtitles 16-20pt, labels 10-14pt; consistent rounded pill info labels; consistent thin-line icon style; crisp product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero product angle and scale with balanced composition margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，干净合规的白底主图
shots.camera: slight front 3/4 angle, eye-level, backpack standing upright, full product visible and not clipped
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio lighting, soft front-left key with fill, soft contact shadow
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The backpack standing upright at a slight front 3/4 angle, eye-level, full silhouette visible and not clipped by the frame. Bright even high-key studio lighting, soft front-left key with fill, a soft contact shadow grounding the backpack on the surface. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The backpack fills 60-70% of the frame with even margins on all sides. 8K, commercial outdoor-gear e-commerce quality. Negative: no props, no hands, no people, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no cut-off edges, no floating product, no harsh reflections.

shots.intent: 一秒传达户外大容量的核心卖点，承接点击
shots.camera: low angle looking slightly upward at the backpack on a dark matte wood surface, heroic feel
shots.lighting: soft directional key from the left, gentle gradient falloff, soft contact shadow
shots.textZone: upper half headline zone: one large headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #33383D and one short rounded pill 「{callout_1}」 in #FFFFFF on a solid #5E969E pill
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce cover hero of {product} standing on a dark matte wood surface #3B3230, photographed from a low angle looking slightly upward for a bold heroic feel. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The backpack occupies 50-60% of the frame in the lower part. The upper half carries the cover typography: one large headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #33383D and one short rounded pill 「{callout_1}」 in #FFFFFF on a solid #5E969E pill, both clearly readable against the flat misty grey-blue #E8EEF0 background. Soft directional key light from the left, gentle contact shadow. Negative: no dense body text, no invented capacity or waterproof ratings, no watermark, no fake logo, no people, no decorative plants covering the product.

shots.intent: 用图标矩阵快速铺开核心卖点，消除疑虑
shots.camera: infographic layout: product photo band across the top at a front 3/4 angle, clean 2x3 icon grid below
shots.lighting: even high-key flat lighting, no dramatic shadow
shots.props: six thin-line icons in #5E969E, one per grid cell
shots.whitespace: about 15% panel margins around the photo band and between grid cells
shots.textZone: six rounded label areas in a 2x3 grid reading 「{selling_point_2}」 「{selling_point_3}」 「{selling_point_4}」 「{callout_2}」 「{callout_3}」 「{callout_4}」 in #33383D
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce infographic layout for {product}: a product photo band across the top at a front 3/4 angle filling 50-60% of the band, and a clean 2x3 thin-line icon grid below with about 15% panel margins. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even high-key flat lighting, no dramatic shadow. Background clean white #FFFFFF. Each grid cell pairs one thin-line icon in #5E969E with one short rounded label in #33383D: 「{selling_point_2}」 「{selling_point_3}」 「{selling_point_4}」 「{callout_2}」 「{callout_3}」 「{callout_4}」. Negative: no dense body text, no invented specs or certifications, no tiny unreadable text, no watermark, no fake logo, no photorealistic icons.

shots.intent: 放大普通背包勒肩、负载不稳的痛点，引出背负舒适
shots.camera: matched split-screen framing with identical side-profile camera on both panels, torso level, no face visible
shots.lighting: left panel flat harsher light; right panel softer directional light
shots.background: both panels a plain neutral grey #DDE3E5
shots.textZone: one short label per panel: 「{callout_5}」 on the left, 「{callout_6}」 on the right, in #33383D
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point split screen, two matched panels with identical side-profile camera and framing, torso level, no face visible. Left panel: a generic unbranded bulky backpack with thin straps digging into a hiker's shoulder under flat harsher light, conveying shoulder strain on a long trek. Right panel: {product} worn with wide padded straps sitting stable and comfortable under softer directional light. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Background a plain neutral grey #DDE3E5 on both panels. One short label per panel: 「{callout_5}」 and 「{callout_6}」 in #33383D. The worn backpack fills 50-60% of each panel with even margins. Negative: no visible face, no identifiable brand on the left backpack, no fabricated statistics, no deformed hands or fingers, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 让买家代入户外徒步场景，激发自我投射
shots.camera: rear 45-degree view following a hiker on a mountain gravel trail, face not visible, backpack clearly the subject
shots.lighting: natural morning daylight around 5500K from the upper left, soft shadows, slight haze in the valley
shots.background: real mountain trail with rock, low shrubs and a hazy ridge line, natural environment
shots.props: a trekking pole in the hiker's hand, not covering the product
shots.whitespace: natural breathing room from the surrounding landscape and trail
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene: {product} worn by a hiker seen from a rear 45-degree angle walking a mountain gravel trail, face not visible, the backpack clearly the subject. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Natural morning daylight around 5500K from the upper left, soft shadows, slight haze on the ridge line. Real outdoor environment with grey rock #97928A and low shrubs. One trekking pole as a scale anchor, not covering the product. The backpack with the hiker occupies 40-50% of the frame, with the open trail and landscape giving natural breathing room around them. Candid documentary feel, not retouched. Negative: no visible face, no brand logos on clothing, no hands covering the product, no impossible shadows, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no cluttered scene.

shots.intent: 微距证明五金扣具与织带皮革的用料做工
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro, shallow depth of field, tight zoom on the strap, buckle and webbing of the backpack, foreground sharp
shots.lighting: raking side light from the right revealing canvas weave and leather grain, controlled highlight on the metal buckle
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of {product}, tight zoom on its strap, buckle and webbing hardware. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Shallow depth of field around f/2.8, foreground sharp. Raking side light from the right revealing the canvas weave and leather grain, a controlled highlight on the metal buckle. Neutral matte background #E8EEF0. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame, minimal whitespace, the material texture is the whole point. Negative: no blurry subject, no deformed hardware, no duplicated straps, no invented brand engraving on the buckle, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 并排展示多色可选，让买家按喜好下单
shots.camera: three identical front 3/4 hero-angle units in a row, same scale and lighting across all
shots.lighting: identical even soft studio light on all three units, soft contact shadows
shots.background: clean white #FFFFFF with a subtle mist grey-blue #E8EEF0 floor band
shots.whitespace: even white gutters between the three units and their labels
shots.textZone: one short rounded label under each variant: 「{callout_7}」 「{callout_8}」 「{callout_9}」 in #33383D
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce variant row of {product} in three colorways: charcoal grey #4A4A4F, dusty teal #5E969E and earth brown #8B5A33, all shown at the same front 3/4 hero angle, same scale, identical lighting. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even soft studio light with soft contact shadows, consistent across all three units. Background clean white #FFFFFF with a subtle floor band of mist grey-blue #E8EEF0. One short rounded label under each variant: 「{callout_7}」 「{callout_8}」 「{callout_9}」 in #33383D, separated by even white gutters. The three units occupy 60-70% of the frame overall. Negative: no lighting drift between variants, no texture loss on the dark colorway, no extra units, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text.

shots.intent: 收口促单，用行动号召与利益点完成转化
shots.camera: high 45-degree angle looking down at the backpack on a dark matte wood surface
shots.lighting: brand-consistent soft directional key from the left, slightly punchier contrast, soft contact shadow
shots.textZone: one short headline 「{selling_point_8}」 in #33383D, one solid CTA pill 「{callout_1}」 in #FFFFFF on a #5E969E pill, and one solid rounded offer pill 「{callout_2}」 in #FFFFFF on a leather-brown #A9683C pill
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce closing CTA shot of {product} on a dark matte wood surface #3B3230, photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Soft directional key light from the left with slightly punchier contrast, soft contact shadow. Background flat misty grey-blue #E8EEF0. The backpack fills 60-70% of the frame. Typography block: one short headline 「{selling_point_8}」 in #33383D, one solid CTA pill 「{callout_1}」 in #FFFFFF on a #5E969E pill, and one solid rounded offer pill 「{callout_2}」 in #FFFFFF on a leather-brown #A9683C pill. Negative: no invented discounts, prices or countdowns, no dense body text, no watermark, no fake logo, no QR code, no people.

provenance.notes: 从 8 张复古帆布登山背包爆款长图切片提炼；已剥离源品牌字、图库水印、二维码与会员推广块、虚构销量数据、乱码英文填充文案及全部原文案（卖点与提示文案改用 selling_point/callout 槽位，投放时填入）；产品一律以 {product} 占位，场景人物仅保留徒步者角色且不露脸。容量、防水等级、认证等不可验证数据一律不出现，信任感由微距镜可见的用料做工细节承载。
